extracted.name: Cucumber-Watermelon Salad
extracted.description: This cool, refreshing summer salad is oh so delicious! Sweet and tangy at the same time.
instruction_lines: Place the watermelon and cucumber cubes in a large bowl, and gently toss with the salt and sugar. Drizzle with balsamic vinegar and toss to coat. Refrigerate for 15 minutes, then gently toss one last time before serving.
